messages:
alex_support: FYI — acme-prod reporting inconsistent embedding dimensions when toggling quant_profile. Single call returns 1536 dims, batched requests sometimes return 1024. They think fps/int8 is involved. Repro steps pasted below.

joel_support: Can you paste the exact curl they used and the SDK version?

alex_support: pasted below (customer redacted user/token):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-large-v1","input":["doc1","doc2",...],"quant_profile":"int8","batch_size":8}'
```

maya_ml: Quick thought — we onboarded an int8-optimized variant that also uses a reduced projection head (1024) to save memory for latency-sensitive SKUs. If requests are being routed to that variant the embedding dim change is expected. But we should NEVER return mixed dims in the same batch.

sam_runtime: Can you share a raw response they received? Also need server-side request ids so we can correlate. There was a routing change two weeks ago that does dynamic variant fallback for throughput. Might be related.

alex_support: customer pasted a minimal response snippet: 
```json
{"data":[{"embedding":[...1536 numbers...] ,"index":0},{"embedding":[...1024 numbers...],"index":1}],"model":"redwood-embed-large-v1"}
```

joel_support: ugh — mixed dims in the same response. That's a serious bug if true. We should treat as high severity.

maya_ml: Hypotheses: 1) SDK/request layer allowed a per-item override that caused routing to different variant (e.g., quant_profile applied per-item), 2) runtime sharded the batch across capacity pools and a fallback variant with smaller projection was used for some shards, 3) model_catalog metadata mismatch where model name maps to multiple variants with different embedding_projection sizes.

tanya_prod: We shipped an automatic "throughput -> quant_profile" mapping in the console (to suggest int8 for throughput). Did we also ship a silent model aliasing rule? If so, customers might be routed to a different model variant without explicit model_version.

sam_runtime: Checked logs for request id rwd:acme:7834 (from customer). Routing trace: 
```
2026-07-15T14:22:10Z TRACE request=acme:7834 route_decision: model_alias_lookup -> redwood-embed-large-v1 -> resolved_variant redwood-embed-large-v1-int8-1024
2026-07-15T14:22:10Z TRACE batch_shard=0 -> variant redwood-embed-large-v1-1536-fp16
2026-07-15T14:22:11Z TRACE batch_shard=1 -> variant redwood-embed-large-v1-int8-1024 (fallback for capacity)
```

maya_ml: There's the issue — the alias resolved to multiple variants and shard-level fallback picked a different projection head. We should _never_ mix projection dims across items in one response.

alex_support: Customer wants a repro they can run. Suggested support repro (single-item and batch) below.
```bash
# single item, force fp16
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-large-v1","input":"hello world","quant_profile":"fp16"}'

# batch that previously failed
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-large-v1","input":["doc1","doc2","doc3","doc4"],"quant_profile":"int8","batch_size":4}'
```

joel_support: Ask customer to include response headers: `x-request-id`, `x-model-variant`, and attach raw body. That will speed triage.

acme_ops: Confirmed — we see `x-model-variant: redwood-embed-large-v1-int8-1024` on some items and `redwood-embed-large-v1-fp16-1536` on others. We did not pass per-item quant overrides. We used the JS SDK v1.4.1.

sam_runtime: Action items from runtime: 1) Block mixing of embedding dims in a single response by validating model metadata before assembling batch response; 2) Add a fast-fail if shard-level variant resolution would yield differing embedding sizes; 3) Instrument routing to emit clear headers per-item. I'll open a patch and backfill tests.

maya_ml: Action items from ML: 1) Update model_catalog to ensure alias -> single projection-size invariant for a given model alias or make console warn prominently; 2) Roll forward a metadata check into model onboarding to reject variants that change output dim without a new model name.

tanya_prod: We'll add a console notice and a changelog entry. Also adding a default knob: if user sets `model` explicitly (not alias), do not auto-fallback to variants with different output dims.

alex_support: Customer confirmed that forcing `model=redwood-embed-large-v1-fp16-1536` in their request returns consistent 1536 dims for all items. They asked for ETA on a fix.

sam_runtime: ETA for server patch = 48 hours for hotfix to validate dims and reject mixed responses. Full fix (catalog invariant + tests) in next weekly release.

acme_ops: thanks. Can you also confirm whether billing/usage will be billed differently when they hit int8 vs fp16? We saw different unit counts.

joel_support: Billing: different variants have different per-token/embedding unit prices. We'll flag the customer's billing account and prevent surprise overages during the investigation.

alex_support: Marking this thread high-priority and escalating. I'll DM the customer the repro that forces explicit model_variant and ask for `x-request-id` headers on any future hits. :thumbsup:

maya_ml: Also adding a short integration test to the embedding harness that runs a mixed-variant simulation to ensure we never emit mixed dims.

sam_runtime: Filed issue RW-embed-2439 and linked traces.

joel_support: Thanks team — keeping customer updated.

acme_ops: Confirmed workaround works. Will monitor. Appreciate the quick triage. :pray:
